services.name: Niagara City Cruises
services.desc: Explore downtown Toronto on foot, from Union Station and the PATH to St. Lawrence Market and Old Town, then finish on the waterfront with an optional 1-hour Toronto harbour cruise. See Toronto's downtown core come to life on a relaxed small-group walking tour that finishes right at the waterfront. Starting steps from Union Station, your guide shares stories of railways, skyscrapers, and sports legends as you wind through the PATH and past views of the soaring CN Tower.
